Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Appropriate personal protective equpment must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Circuit breaker must be fully isolated
Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker

The circuit breaker should be switched off and ground the CB an both 
 sides.
Switch off control current for CB (d.c)
Complete set of maintenance hand tools
Portable pressure gauges, Emergency light, Blower

Carryout the annual inspection as stated in the MPIS 
 document # CB-125-r0
Check any gas leaks using SF6 gas detector,

With the control circuit at its rated voltage and SF6 air systems at their 
 respective rated pressures, perform same closing and opening operations, 
 recording the operation times with a multichannel oscillograph

If the time value don't 
 corresponding to those indicated in the factory certificates, the 
 filters, orifices and control valves of the operating mechanisms that show 
 abnormal values shall be cleaned out, inspected and reassembled.
Take an SF6sample from each breaker pole and measure its humidity.

If the gas moisture in one pole is higher than 
 250 PPMv, the SF6 contained in it must be reconditioned and the
 molecular 
 sieves replaced.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
document outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
every five years or every 500 
operation as indicated 
by Y5 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated at Rabt Aswan 
220kv
substation, upper Egypt zone, ECET
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Appropriate personal protective equpment must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Circuit breaker must be fully isolated
Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker
The circuit breaker should be switched off and ground the CB an both 
 sides.
Switch off control current for CB (d.c)
Switch on the ventilation
Tools and Equipment
Safety glove, 
 breathing, helmet, shoes
Complete set of maintenance hand tools
Portable pressure gauges, Emergency light, Blower
Timing equipment, SF6 Gas detector
Work to be Carried Out
Carryout the annual inspection as stated in the MPIS 
 document # CB-125-r0
Check any gas leaks using SF6 gas detector,
With the control circuit at its rated voltage and SF6 air systems at their 
 respective rated pressures, perform same closing and opening operations, 
 recording the operation times with a multichannel oscillograph
If the time value don't 
 corresponding to those indicated in the factory certificates, the 
 filters, orifices and control valves of the operating mechanisms that show 
 abnormal values shall be cleaned out, inspected and reassembled.
Measure the operating tims again,
Take an SF6sample from each breaker pole and measure its humidity.
If the gas moisture in one pole is higher than 
 250 PPMv, the SF6 contained in it must be reconditioned and the
 molecular 
 sieves replaced.
